items.source: Explicitly wire the EntityManagerFactory to be used with the repositories being detected by the repositories element. Usually used if multiple EntityManagerFactory beans are used within the application. If not configured, Spring Data automatically looks up the EntityManagerFactory bean with the name entityManagerFactory in the ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 显式地将 `EntityManagerFactory` 配置为与由 `repositories` 元素检测到的仓库一起使用。通常在应用程序中使用多个 `EntityManagerFactory` 豆时采用此方法。如果未进行配置，Spring Data 会自动在 `ApplicationContext` 中查找名为 `entityManagerFactory` 的 `EntityManagerFactory` 豆。

items.source: The preceding configuration class sets up an embedded HSQL database by using the EmbeddedDatabaseBuilder API of spring-jdbc. Spring Data then sets up an EntityManagerFactory and uses Hibernate as the sample persistence provider. The last infrastructure component declared here is the JpaTransactionManager. Finally, the example activates Spring Data JPA repositories by using the @EnableJpaRepositories annotation, which essentially carries the same attributes as the XML namespace. If no base package is configured, it uses the one in which the configuration class resides.
items.translation: 上述配置类通过 `EmbeddedDatabaseBuilder` API 设置了嵌入式 HSQL 数据库，该 API 属于 `spring-jdbc`。随后，Spring Data 会设置一个 `EntityManagerFactory`》，并使用 Hibernate 作为示例持久化提供者。此处声明的最后一个基础设施组件是 `JpaTransactionManager`。最后，该示例通过 `@EnableJpaRepositories` 注解激活 Spring Data JPA 仓库，该注解本质上具有与 XML 命名空间相同的属性。如果未配置基础包，则使用配置类所在的包。

items.source: Explicitly wire the PlatformTransactionManager to be used with the repositories being detected by the repositories element. Usually only necessary if multiple transaction managers or EntityManagerFactory beans have been configured. Default to a single defined PlatformTransactionManager inside the current ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 显式地将 `PlatformTransactionManager` 配置为与由 `repositories` 元素检测到的仓库一起使用。通常仅在配置了多个事务管理器或 `EntityManagerFactory` Bean 时才需要这样做。默认情况下，使用当前 `ApplicationContext` 中定义的单个 `PlatformTransactionManager`。

items.source: Using the repositories element it activates persistence exception translation for all beans annotated with @Repository, to let exceptions being thrown by the JPA persistence providers be converted into Spring’s DataAccessException hierarchy.
items.translation: 使用 `repositories` 元素可为所有带有 `@Repository` 注解的 Bean 启用持久化异常翻译，从而将 JPA 持久化提供者抛出的异常转换为 Spring 的 `DataAccessException` 层次结构中的异常。

items.source: DEFERRED — Fundamentally the same mode of operation as LAZY, but triggering repository initialization in response to a ContextRefreshedEvent so that repositories are verified before the application has completely started.
items.translation: DEFERRED——其基本操作模式与LAZY相同，但会在响应ContextRefreshedEvent时触发仓库初始化，从而确保在应用程序完全启动之前验证仓库。

items.source: By default, Spring Data JPA repositories are regular Spring beans. They are singleton scoped and eagerly initialized. During startup, they already interact with the JPA EntityManager for verification and metadata analysis purposes. Spring Framework supports the initialization of the JPA EntityManagerFactory in a background thread because that process usually takes up a significant amount of startup time in a Spring application. To make use of that background initialization effectively, we need to make sure that JPA repositories are initialized as late as possible.
items.translation: 默认情况下，Spring Data JPA 仓库是普通的 Spring Bean。它们是单例作用域并 eagerly（急切）初始化。在启动过程中，它们已经与 JPA EntityManager 进行交互，用于验证和元数据分析目的。Spring Framework 支持在后台线程中初始化 JPA EntityManagerFactory，因为该过程通常在 Spring 应用中占用大量启动时间。为了有效利用这种后台初始化机制，我们需要确保 JPA 仓库尽可能晚地进行初始化。

items.source: As of Spring Data JPA 2.1 you can now configure a BootstrapMode (either via the @EnableJpaRepositories annotation or the XML namespace) that takes the following values:
items.translation: 从 Spring Data JPA 2.1 开始，您现在可以通过 @EnableJpaRepositories 注解或 XML 命名空间配置一个 BootstrapMode，其可取值如下：

items.source: DEFAULT (default) — Repositories are instantiated eagerly unless explicitly annotated with @Lazy. The lazification only has effect if no client bean needs an instance of the repository as that will require the initialization of the repository bean.
items.translation: DEFAULT（默认）—— 除非显式标注了 @Lazy，否则仓库将被急切实例化。 只有当没有客户端 Bean 需要该仓库的实例时，懒加载才会生效；因为如果有客户端 Bean 依赖该仓库，就会触发仓库 Bean 的初始化。

items.source: In case you bootstrap JPA asynchronously, DEFERRED is a reasonable default as it will make sure the Spring Data JPA bootstrap only waits for the EntityManagerFactory setup if that itself takes longer than initializing all other application components. Still, it makes sure that repositories are properly initialized and validated before the application signals it’s up.
items.translation: 如果您异步引导 JPA，则 `DEFERRED` 是一个合理的默认值，因为它能确保 Spring Data JPA 的引导仅在 `EntityManagerFactory` 的配置时间超过所有其他应用组件初始化时间的情况下才等待其完成。尽管如此，它仍能保证在应用程序报告启动就绪之前，仓库（repositories）已得到正确的初始化和验证。

items.source: LAZY — Implicitly declares all repository beans lazy and also causes lazy initialization proxies to be created to be injected into client beans. That means, that repositories will not get instantiated if the client bean is simply storing the instance in a field and not making use of the repository during initialization. Repository instances will be initialized and verified upon first interaction with the repository.
items.translation: LAZY — 隐式声明所有存储库 Bean 为懒加载，并导致创建懒初始化代理以注入到客户端 Bean 中。 这意味着，如果客户端 Bean 仅在字段中存储实例而在初始化期间未使用存储库，则存储库将不会被实例化。 存储库实例将在首次与存储库交互时进行初始化和验证。

items.source: LAZY is a decent choice for testing scenarios and local development. Once you are pretty sure that repositories can properly bootstrap, or in cases where you are testing other parts of the application, running verification for all repositories might unnecessarily increase the startup time. The same applies to local development in which you only access parts of the application that might need to have a single repository initialized.
items.translation: LAZY 是一个不错的选择，适用于测试场景和本地开发。一旦您确信仓库能够正确引导启动，或者在测试应用程序的其他部分时，为所有仓库运行验证可能会不必要地增加启动时间。同样的情况也适用于本地开发，此时您可能只需访问应用程序的某些部分，而这些部分可能只需要初始化单个仓库。

items.source: Which is better, JavaConfig or XML? XML is how Spring was configured long ago. In today’s era of fast-growing Java, record types, annotations, and more, new projects typically use as much pure Java as possible. While there is no immediate plan to remove XML support, some of the newest features MAY not be available through XML.
items.translation: JavaConfig 和 XML 哪个更好？XML 是 Spring 早期使用的配置方式。在当今 Java 快速发展的时代，随着记录类型、注解等新特性的出现，新项目通常会尽可能多地使用纯 Java 代码。虽然目前没有立即移除 XML 支持的计划，但部分最新功能可能无法通过 XML 实现。
